Product Features

  • Overall size: The total size of this TV cabinet is 180 x 40 x 49 cm, suitable for TVs around 80, 75 and 70 inches in size, creating a coordinated audiovisual center for the living room.
  • High-gloss design: The front is designed to be high-gloss (the high-gloss area is limited to the white part of the front), which provides a stylish and bright appearance. It not only increases visual sophistication, but is also easy to clean and maintain. Daily stains can be removed by gently wiping.
  • 4 cabinets, large storage space: Equipped with 4 cabinets, the two adjacent cabinets have adjustable partitions inside, which can be divided into 2 levels. The space can be flexibly adjusted to the size of the items to meet the storage needs of items of different sizes. Inside, there are a total of 6 hidden storage areas to further expand the storage capacity.
  • Large storage area: In addition to the TV, a large shelf allows you to place green plants, picture frames and other decorations to give the living room a cultural or artistic atmosphere and enhance the style of the room.
  • 8 Table Legs, Stable Load Capacity: With 8 table legs, it provides stable support. The recommended total load capacity is 52 kg. It can support TVs and various storage items stably. It is sturdy and durable, and it does not deform easily after prolonged use.
  • Material: Made of MDF, the material is sturdy, which ensures the stability and durability of the TV cabinet and allows for a long period of stable use.
  • Color: The overall color is white with black lines, which is simple yet stylish. The symmetrical structure design makes the TV cabinet look more beautiful and coordinated, and can be easily integrated into various interior styles such as modern and slightly luxurious.
  • Large Storage Space: The hidden storage design allows various items to be cleverly stored, the surface of the TV cabinet remains clean, and the living space looks more refreshing and tidy.
  • Adjustable Partitions: From the flexible storage of adjustable partitions, to the easy-to-clean high-gloss look, to the beautiful symmetrical structure, each design takes into account both practicality and aesthetics, bringing comfort and quality to living room life.
  • Note: This product comes in two packages and may arrive with a time delay. Please make sure both packages have arrived before assembly.
